_note: NOT the wire format. The platform channel is StandardMessageCodec (binary). These are the same events after JSON serialization. Values are real, captured 2026-08-19T11:37:13 from a ZK9500.

statusChangeStream._note: Raw map as delivered, keys exactly as the native side sets them.

decoded._note: Same two events, parsed into something you'd actually send to a backend.

identify.scoreScale: native — NOT 0-100. SDK threshold arg is 70, observed good match 536.

imageStream._note: Arrives as raw Uint8List, NOT base64 and NOT inside any map. No JSON envelope at all. Base64 only if you encode it yourself.

backend_post._note: Suggested shape for POST /api/fingerprints on ENROLL_SUCCESS. This one IS real JSON — you build it.
